notes: The error banner's Continue can restart every stopped thread on another model: a chevron beside Continue / Continue all opens "Continue as" with the model picker and effort control, and Continue there switches each errored thread in the tree (errored subagents too) before its continue turn. The same provider keeps the conversation; another provider gets the transcript handoff a composer switch uses. session.continue takes optional provider/model/reasoning; send()'s switch logic moved into applyRunSettings in sessions.ts so both paths share it. Tests: sessions-limits.test.ts (continue on another model saves model and effort, picks the account again, sends the continue to the new process), commands.test.ts (the RPC carries the run settings).
